• Acquire competence in accordance with the training ordinance and plan for the apprenticeship
• Clean and maintain buildings, areas, facilities and facilities, store goods and check stocks
• Take responsibility for the periodic maintenance, intermediate, basic and special cleanings of the various buildings
• Clean and maintain equipment, machines and tools
• Independently select the quantity and concentration of cleaning agents and provide any aids
• Completed compulsory schooling with good grades
• Logical thinking skills and precise way of working
• Motivated and ready for action
• Enjoyment of practical work
• Reliable and responsible
• Team-oriented and good manners
• No allergies (cleaning products) and free from giddiness
